key_insight: NLP can automate keyword extraction for crowdsourced archives at scale, but the best results depend strongly on the chosen model and no single approach fully solves the task.
engineering_relevance: The study highlights a practical pipeline decision for digital humanities and knowledge mining systems: balance extraction quality, scalability, and stewardship responsibilities when deploying AI for metadata generation.
method: Compared Named Entity Recognition, Keyword Extraction, and Topic Modelling
Tested methods across traditional statistical models and modern GenAI neural networks
Evaluated performance on the Their Finest Hour Online Archive crowdsourced WWII collection
evidence_signal: The project combined quantitative and qualitative evaluation across multiple AI techniques and found that model choice significantly shaped the extracted keywords and their usefulness.
watch_item: Generative AI can improve abstractive coverage but raises accountability and stewardship risks, so open-weight extractive models may be safer for responsible deployment.
paper_title: Letting the Data Speak: Extracting Keywords from Crowdsourced Collections with AI
